<!-- generated by harness-summit; edits are overwritten by `harness-summit install` -->

Call the `summit_group` tool of the harness-summit MCP server with `name` set to the user text after the command: `$ARGUMENTS`. If that text ends with `--force`, remove `--force` from the group name and also pass `force` set to true.

Report the new group in one short line.
